variables.name: MT_UNIFORMS_SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Shopify Admin API access token for the historical order import. Shopify has no native order CSV import at any plan level, so orders.jsonl must go through the Admin API. Minimum scopes: write_orders, read_products. write_customers ONLY if approval item 7 rules that customers migrate. Do not grant broader scopes "to be safe" — this token can read every customer and order in the new store.
variables.rotation: Revoke immediately after the one-time import completes. This is a migration credential with a defined end, not a standing integration token, and leaving it live is the failure mode.
consumers: the order-import run against orders.jsonl (tooling not yet written)

variables.name: MT_UNIFORMS_SHOPIFY_DEV_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.purpose: The same token for the Shopify DEVELOPMENT store, used to rehearse the import and to prove that native CSV import actually creates more than 100 variants on a single product before the production run depends on it.
variables.rotation: on compromise or when the development store is torn down
consumers: the order-import run against orders.jsonl (tooling not yet written)
